subject: WRITE statement
notes: kb/Work PB854. a) PositionOnLogicalPage records WHICH arm caused the end-of-page condition (GR26 a) -> EC-I-O-EOP-OVERFLOW, GR26 b) -> EC-I-O-EOP) and WriteSucceeded reports the name beside the successful '00' through the connector's rule-named condition channel (the one EC-I-O-LINAGE uses); both names now have mask bits. b) the END-OF-PAGE phrase runs on the success guard, and __IoCheckEc's success arm dispatches nothing for an EOP name when the phrase is present, while the condition is still SET (EXCEPTION-STATUS names it inside the phrase). c) the exception-checking PERFORM's WHEN takes it and the matching USE is ignored (2023 golden). d)/e) the USE declarative, or nothing. RELATIVE/INDEXED connectors present no page and raise neither name. COBOL-85 has the phrase but not the names (negative: COBOL0878).
